messages:
maria: hitting a weird leak with the Go generator SDK when cancelling a parent ctx mid-stream. goroutine stays alive and keeps holding the KV cache. anyone seen this?

sam: can you paste a tiny repro? is this the generator API or the streaming/generator combo?

maria: minimal repro below. starts a generator stream with ctx from HTTP request, then request times out -> ctx canceled, but generator goroutine doesn't exit.

```go
func handle(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    ctx := r.Context()
    gen := client.NewGenerator() // using sdk v0.9.x
    stream, err := gen.GenerateStream(ctx, opts)
    if err != nil {
        return
    }
    for token := range stream.Tokens() {
        fmt.Fprint(w, token)
    }
}
```

jordan: ugh. we've seen a similar pattern where the SDK's internal handshake blocks on auth refresh and isn't selecting on ctx.Done(). two things to check: 1) whether stream.Close() is called by the SDK on ctx cancel and 2) whether auth token refresh path can block briefly.

maria: i verified there's no explicit Close exposed on the stream in this version. stream.Tokens() is just a channel. when ctx cancels, the http request dies but the internal goroutine stuck in the read loop stays.

sam: that's a bad ergonomics combo — relying only on ctx propagation without an explicit abort/Close makes it brittle. proposal: SDK should expose an explicit Cancel() or Close() on generator streams and also ensure auth refresh is context-aware.

jordan: agreed. quick workaround: spawn a watcher goroutine that does:

```go
watchCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
go func(){
    select {
    case <-ctx.Done():
        stream.Close() // if available in your version, or trigger client.Transport.CloseIdleConnections()
    case <-watchCtx.Done():
    }
}()
```

But i know that's ugly. also racey if auth refresh blocks on a mutex that stream.Close() tries to acquire.

maria: thanks, i'll try the watcher hack. opening an issue + sample app with the repro. anyone want to review API suggestion? thinking: type GeneratorStream interface { Tokens() <-chan string; Close() error } and Make GenerateStream return (GeneratorStream, error).

sam: +1 for the interface. also add a Context-aware Close or CloseWithContext(ctx) so handlers can pass the request ctx for cooperative shutdown.

ci-bot: flaky-test: generator_stream_cancelation_test failed in CI (run/2026-03-22). logging the failure to the issue when you open it.

jordan: fwiw, auth team patched a similar issue last quarter where the refresh used a long-lived lock. if you include the SDK version in the issue they can triage faster.

maria: will do. thanks all. i'll drop the issue link here once created and include the small sample app. :pray:
